Maya: Hey team — quick scenario: I'm on parental leave starting May 15 in the US, but planning to move back to the UK permanently during leave and want to return to work part-time from the UK after 10w. What do I need to do for payroll, benefits, and immigration? Any restrictions?

Priya (People Ops): Congrats Maya! Short answer: there's a few moving parts. You need to file leave as usual, and separately open a relocation/change-of-workcountry request. People Ops, Payroll, Benefits, and Legal all need to coordinate.

Priya (People Ops): Key points: 1) Parental leave pay is tied to employment eligibility — you can receive paid parental leave while abroad if payroll/payments can be arranged. 2) Moving countries can change tax withholding, social contributions, and benefit eligibility (UK pension auto-enrolment). 3) Immigration: if you're moving back permanently you won't need a work visa in the UK, but if it's temporary Legal should advise.

Maya: Timeline question 7: I want to start leave May 15 (US payroll), move Jun 20, and return Aug 1 from UK at 0.6 FTE. Is that feasible?

Diego (Payroll): Feasible but we need exact effective dates by payroll cutoff. For the US payroll run, parental-pay weeks through the move date will be paid in USD via the US payroll. After you change work country we may need to switch you to UK payroll for payments starting the next pay period. That can affect pay frequency and banking. Provide passport/addr proof for payroll change.

Diego (Payroll): Actions:
```
- Submit leave request (May 15 start)
- Submit change-of-workcountry form (effective Jun 20)
- Provide UK bank details & tax residency docs
- Payroll will process split-country payments: US-filed earnings up to Jun 20, UK-filed thereafter
```

Lina (Legal): Immigration & compliance: If permanent move, confirm your legal right to work in UK. We're not doing secondment, it's a change to work location, so contracts may need amendment (working law differs). Also watch cross-border social security treaties — Legal will check treaties for dual contributions.

Ravi (Benefits): Health plan coverage: US health insurance won't cover you when you're outside the US long-term. If you move to the UK permanently, you'll be removed from US medical plan effective the change date and enrolled in the UK local plan or given local-country benefit options. Pension: UK pension auto-enrolment rules may apply if UK payroll and eligible. We'll run an eligibility check once payroll flags the change.

Maya: If I'm still on parental leave (paid) while moving, will health premiums continue to be deducted or prorated?

Ravi (Benefits): While on paid leave employer contributions typically continue until the change-of-country effective date. After that, the US medical plan will be terminated and we'll provide alternatives. You should discuss any dependents coverage too.

Sam (Manager): For team coverage: we may need a temp contractor from Jun 20 through Aug to cover overlap. Finance: submit intake soon. Also approve Maya's 0.6 return from Aug 1 subject to visa/payroll updates.

Priya (People Ops): Checklist for Maya (please complete ASAP):
```
- File parental leave in HR portal (select start May 15) and attach birth docs
- Submit "Change of Work Country" form with effective date Jun 20
- Send UK bank details and proof of UK address to payroll
- Book 15-min call with People Ops + Payroll + Benefits + Legal (I'll schedule)
- Manager to open finance intake for contractor coverage (if needed)
- Indicate planned FTE on return (0.6) in portal
```

Maya: Thanks 7. Also any impact on stock vesting or RSU tax withholding?

Diego (Payroll): Potentially yes. Equity tax withholding is country-specific. We will coordinate with Comp/Equity team to confirm how withholding will be handled for the portion of vesting while on UK payroll. Expect a separate note.

Lina (Legal): Also flag GDPR/data transfer considerations if you access US systems from UK. We'll advise on remote access and any contractual amendments.

hr-bot: Policy links: Parental leave: https://redwood.example.company/hr/parental-leave. International work policy: https://redwood.example.company/hr/international-work. Leave docs must be attached to portal request.

Maya: Great, I'll submit the portal request and change-of-country form today. Please add the 15-min sync 7.

Priya (People Ops): Received. I'll schedule the sync with Diego, Ravi, and Lina this afternoon and DM you the invite. We'll send a one-pager summary after the call.

Sam (Manager): Thanks team 44d. We'll plan coverage accordingly.

(End of thread)
